name: cogawaken
description: Cognitive reflection coaching with replayable turns, explicit provenance and branched methods.

displayDescription.zh: 围绕真实困境分析与追问，区分事实和解释，看见思考模式，设计小实验并复盘，支持本地保存练习记录。
displayDescription.en: Explore concrete dilemmas, distinguish observations and interpretations, test assumptions and review experiments with optional local records.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我被一件事卡住了，请陪我梳理自己的思考过程。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me examine my thinking about a concrete dilemma.

quickPrompts.zh: 我被一件事卡住了，请陪我梳理自己的思考过程。
quickPrompts.en: Help me examine my thinking about a concrete dilemma.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想复盘一次冲动反应，一次只问我一个问题。
quickPrompts.en: Help me review an impulsive reaction, one question at a time.

quickPrompts.zh: 我带回了上次练习的结果，帮我看看哪些判断需要调整。
quickPrompts.en: Help me review an experiment and update my assumptions.
